name: Advanced Duplicator
description: A bigger Duplicator for serious building. Type /adup for the gold wand. Click a brick to copy it and everything on it, or type /box and click two corners to copy everything between them. Move and turn the copy with the brick keys, flip it with /mirror, and plant it. /cut removes the original so planting the copy moves the build, and /fillcolor paints the original in your spray colour; Ctrl+Z undoes either. /duphelp lists it all. Our own tool, inspired by Zeblote's New Duplicator for Blockland.
